title: KV260 Ising Sampler v4 RTL — Sparse E-MVL (N=128, K=16)

notes.lut_cells_detail: 27136 LUT2 cells (synth_xilinx primitive count); yosys LC estimate 13568 (two LUT2 per LUT6)
notes.spec_estimate_vs_actual: Spec estimated 36250; actual 27136 (25% under estimate — sparse coupling implemented as distributed LUT-RAM rather than BRAM; coupling storage is in the LUT count but combinatorial read pattern precluded BRAM inference)
notes.emvl_rule: sign(h_ema_new) — deterministic majority vote, no sigmoid LUT
notes.decentralization: fully open-source toolchain (yosys OSS-CAD-Suite + iverilog), no closed-source tools required
